output.explanation: I can't give you the names because the warehouse doesn't have them. The sales rep table (marts.dim_sales_reps) only holds sales_rep_id, region and hire_date. I won't guess names or make them up. What I can do is list the IDs and hire dates of the reps in the DACH region: SELECT sales_rep_id, hire_date FROM marts.dim_sales_reps WHERE region = 'DACH' ORDER BY sales_rep_id; This assumes the region is stored exactly as 'DACH'. To match names to those IDs, you'd need the HR or CRM system.
